headline: Prime SE angle at 3ft with offshore dawn — but it's a 3-hour reach for short-period.
today: Best it looks all week here: 2-2.5ft SE on a prime angle with offshore NNE at dawn going cross-off through morning. The 4s period keeps it soft, so it's a nice local session but hard to justify from afar. Log the dawn before the wind turns cross.

daysToWatch.note: Bigger at 2-3ft but onshore S/SW all day — blown out top to bottom. Skip.
Light morning wind but the swell's fading to waist-high. Marginal at best.
